note: KOD's carry adds a 2005-2014 occurrence beside the documented 2015-2023 one, copying its facts as KOD's checked [[errata.field]] corrects them, so both periods state the corrected description and the code list KOD binds without declaring it; its warning attaches to the carried years only. NAER's carry reaches 2015, the original's own first year, so it is refused as stale and NAER keeps only its documented years.
fails_if: `compile_occurrence_corrections` replaces the original's period instead of adding one beside it (KOD loses 2015-2023), copies the uncorrected original or copies coding only for a declared list (the 2005-2014 state has no codes) (the two KOD occurrences disagree on description: conflicting_variable_fact), attaches the carry's warning to the documented years, or admits a carry_scope that overlaps the original's scope (NAER gains 2010-2014 or claims 2015-2016 twice)
